name: Field of Honor: Week 1
summary: A challenge-setter asks you to win ten duels. This is the first of a series of challenges, with another promised afterward.

sections.title: The Next Challenge
sections.body: After you complete the challenge, the setter accepts your effort and says the journey has only begun. Return soon, and another challenge awaits.

faq.q: What do I have to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to win ten duels.
A challenge-setter offers a list of trials for skilled fighters.
The setter says another challenge will be available if you return soon.

attribution: In-game quest text: Field of Honor: Week 1
